column1: # cli-tools — declarative registry of agent CLIs available to orchestrators.
# Read by kb-cli-roster, which writes the per-machine cheatsheet (.active-roster.md)
# injected into every agent's startup context.
# Format (pipe-delimited):  name | kind | candidates | when-text
#   kind = which-any   -> installed if ANY candidate (command name) resolves on PATH
#   kind = path-any    -> installed if ANY candidate (abs path or name) is executable
#   candidates         -> colon-separated list; $HOME is expanded; tried in order
#   when-text          -> one short line: WHEN an agent should reach for this tool
# Add a future CLI (deepseek/kimi/qwen/...) = append ONE line with a known kind.
# NO version numbers anywhere. NO shell snippets — detection logic lives in kb-cli-roster.
# fallback-of: <name>  in column 5 marks this tool as a backup for another (optional).
# claude and codex list the same lookup order the scripts use (bin/_kb_claude_runner.py
# claude_bin, bin/_kb_codex.py codex_bin); scheduled jobs run under launchd, whose PATH
# lacks ~/.local/bin, so the absolute fallbacks matter. KB_CLAUDE_BIN / KB_CODEX_BIN
# overrides are honoured by the scripts, not by this file.
claude     | path-any  | claude:$HOME/.local/bin/claude:/opt/homebrew/bin/claude:/usr/local/bin/claude | write/edit code and run things (skills, integrations, running the project)
codex      | path-any  | $HOME/.local/bin/codex:codex:/opt/homebrew/bin/codex:/usr/local/bin/codex | analysis, planning, conservative second opinion, big research, chunks of code
agy        | path-any  | $HOME/.local/bin/agy:agy            | independent opinion; catches nuances codex and claude missed (call: agy --add-dir "$PWD")
grok       | path-any  | $HOME/.grok/bin/grok:grok           | what people are saying on social media right now; bold, current, no dogma or censorship
notebooklm | path-any  | $HOME/.local/bin/notebooklm:notebooklm | audio/video recap for a human
opencode   | path-any  | $HOME/.opencode/bin/opencode:opencode | backup when grok is unavailable (works with any model) | fallback-of: grok

hermes     | path-any  | $HOME/.local/bin/hermes:hermes       | general-purpose orchestrator (Nous Hermes) on par with claude and codex: execution, research, reviewing claude's work; reads AGENTS.md from cwd on its own; one-shot: hermes -z "<prompt>"; on a Codex subscription it shares quota and model with codex — so its review of codex's work is not independent
